name: cursor-trail-fx
description: A Windows desktop cursor trail effects overlay built with Electron, TypeScript, Vite, and Canvas 2D.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm.cmd run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.pack: npm.cmd run release:prepare && npm.cmd run build && cross-env ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=.cache/electron-builder HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:10808 electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm.cmd run release:prepare && npm.cmd run build && cross-env ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=.cache/electron-builder HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:10808 electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm.cmd run release:prepare && npm.cmd run build && cross-env ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=.cache/electron-builder HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:10808 ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:10808 electron-builder --win
